articles.title: Planet Labs Achieves AI-Powered Real-Time Satellite Imagery Analysis
articles.summary: Planet Labs successfully demonstrated on-board AI object detection from space, using its Pelican-4 satellite to identify aircraft at Alice Springs airport. The breakthrough marks the first reliable autonomous classification from orbit.
articles.significance: First successful real-time AI processing in space - transforms satellites from data collectors to intelligent sensors

articles.title: NASA Expands Commercial Satellite Data Program with Eight New Partnerships
articles.summary: NASA's CSDA program signed agreements with Planet, Airbus, Vantor, Capella, ICEYE, MDA, Umbra and others, providing high-resolution multispectral and SAR data to support Earth science research and applications.
articles.significance: Major expansion of commercial data access for scientific community - broadens quality and coverage of Earth observation

articles.title: NRO Selects EarthDaily for Commercial Earth Observation Support
articles.summary: The National Reconnaissance Office chose EarthDaily Analytics to provide multispectral satellite imagery across 22 spectral bands under the Strategic Commercial Enhancements program, with additional satellites launching through 2026.
articles.significance: Government adoption of commercial multispectral data signals shift toward hybrid public-private Earth observation

articles.title: China Launches Yaogan-50 02 Remote Sensing Satellite
articles.summary: China successfully deployed the Yaogan-50 02 satellite using a modified Long March-6 rocket from Taiyuan Launch Center. The satellite supports land survey, crop yield estimation, and disaster prevention missions.
articles.significance: Strengthens China's Earth observation capabilities for agriculture and disaster management applications

articles.title: Breakthrough Database Enhances Marine Debris Detection from Space
articles.summary: Scientists developed the Marine Debris hyperspectral reference Library collection (MADLib), improving satellite detection of ocean plastics using advanced light pattern analysis from NASA's EMIT sensor.
articles.significance: Revolutionary approach to tracking ocean pollution globally using hyperspectral satellite data

articles.title: SatViT-Seg: New AI Framework for Real-Time Satellite Image Processing
articles.summary: Researchers introduced SatViT-Seg, a Vision Transformer designed for efficient on-board satellite processing, achieving state-of-the-art land cover mapping performance with reduced computational overhead.
articles.significance: Advances satellite edge computing capabilities for real-time land cover analysis and mapping applications
